The '''''Legacy Horizon''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] affiliated with [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
